_doc: Dataset-only joint calibration (sim/real2sim/calib). Every value was fitted on this dataset's frames + recorded joints; see report.json for the residuals, held-out scores and LOEO spreads.

joint_offsets.source: fitted: front arm silhouettes + the wrist camera's views of the world, all five joints (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)

gripper_map.source: fitted: moving-jaw silhouettes in the wrist camera at 1.3-36 % openings (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)

table.source: fitted: resting caps' bottoms seen by the wrist camera, with the fingertip clearance and grasp constraints (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)

_fingertips._why: FK fingertips vs this table plane over the train frames near the table

intrinsics.source: fitted: arm silhouettes + multi-view objects, weak prior at the trusted C270 K (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)

distortion.source: fitted: k1 k2 (p1 p2 k3 held at 0: not supported on held-out) (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)

pose.source: fitted: arm silhouettes (FK of the recorded joints) + objects seen by both cameras (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)
pose._sigma_order: rotation deg about the camera x y z axes, then translation m x y z

latency.source: fitted: images trail observation.state; moving-arm / moving-jaw silhouettes (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)
latency._use: compare a sim frame of state time t with the real image of row t + frames

cap.source: fitted: front blob radius (up-facing end) + wrist silhouettes of the whole cylinder + the blocked-jaw gap (real2sim.calib, report.json sim/outputs/real2sim/testingt_real2sim_20260927_152936/calib/report.json)
cap._note: diameter = the rigid closed-end body the fingers grip (the lip is a thin tamper band, diameter_open_end, that yields); the core cap mesh is a straight cylinder of it
